The pegboard-back cardboard display fits our capabilities well, but sustained non-observation indicates insufficient distinct market traction versus our broader display offer, so resources are better redeployed.

This quarter-pallet cardboard display overlaps heavily with nearby variants, and with no visible continuation after 2019 our absorptive capacity is more valuable in refining the main range than keeping this separate item.
The eighth-pallet format is technically close to our established competence, yet the lack of market visibility for two years implies limited standalone relevance and favors withdrawal.
The wooden display pallet is the least aligned with our paper-based knowledge base, and its absence since 2020 strongly points to weak fit and limited payoff from further development.
